site_name: Digital Realty Lakeside Technology Center (CHI1/ORD10), 350 E Cermak Rd, Chicago IL 60616
verification: Site identity is solid, but no opened page states when the first telecom/data center space opened, went live, or was delivered to a tenant. Three pages agree on a 1999 conversion/retrofit: Data Center Knowledge (byline 2009-01-06) and a second DCK page (byline 2016-10-19) say "converted to telecom use in 1999" by The Carlyle Group; Wikipedia says "In 1999 the building was retrofitted" (that sentence carries no inline citation). A conversion or retrofit year is not an opening year under the rules: it may mark the purchase or the start of the redevelopment rather than first operation, so 1999 remains an inference and 2000 is not ruled out. The Digital Realty ORD10 facility page gives no history dates. Pages that might have settled it were unavailable: the Progressive Engineer feature and Digital Realty's 2008 property page exist only on web.archive.org (not fetchable from this tool), the Chief Engineer article and the live Progressive Engineer URL returned 404, and the City of Chicago landmarks page returned 403. Other URLs tried (a guessed Wikipedia title, a guessed DCK archive URL, a guessed Data Center Frontier URL, a guessed SEC 10-K URL) returned 404 or unrelated content and are not counted as evidence. If the study accepts a conversion year as a proxy, 1999 is the best-supported figure, but that is a rule change for the owner to make, not something these pages verify.

lead.year_evidence_quote: converted to telecom use by the Carlyle Group in 1999

phases.label: Conversion of 1912 printing plant to telecom/carrier hotel use (retrofit year; go-live not stated)

lead.notes: Data Center Knowledge (2009-01-06; repeated in a 2016-10-19 DCK page, both opened) says the building was converted to telecom use in 1999, and Wikipedia says it was retrofitted in 1999 as the first planned carrier hotel in the US. None states when the first space went live, so 1999 is an inferred anchor (2000 equally plausible, one search snippet said renovation in 2000). Same finding as the prior pass; no opening release found.
